snippet.title: Catan single player gameplay 1/3 [PS3]
snippet.description: There wasn't many proper gameplay videos of PS3 version of Catan in Youtube yet, so i decided to put one up myself. I have never played this gem as a boardgame or on other platform, so the gameplay is kind of noobish, sorry about that. But this definitely looks like a real fun game and UI seems to work smoothly. There isn't much with single player but 2-4 player online seems to work perfectly and there is "quick chat" with predefined text and also voice chat can be enabled so you can talk BS with other players while playing :) I'm not sure about other regions but European PSN Store has this for 4.99 €. Really good investment, replay value seems huge.
